name: com.tubroom/tubroom
title: Tubroom
description: Hotel rooms with their own jacuzzi or hot tub, room by room, in the US, Canada and the UK.

tools.name: search_tub_rooms
tools.description: Find hotels where a named room type has its own jacuzzi, whirlpool or hot tub inside the room, in a city, town, state, province, UK nation, or around a point. Returns each hotel with the exact room to book, the tub type, room extras (fireplace, tub for two, heart-shaped, pets), Google rating, the date and source of the last check, and its tubroom.com page. Best rated first, or nearest first for a point search.

place.description: Where the user wants to stay, as they said it: a city or town ("Gatlinburg", "Pigeon Forge, TN", "Toronto"), a US state, Canadian province or UK nation ("Ohio", "Ontario", "Wales"), or a country. Add the state after a comma when a city name is shared. Omit it for a search around a point.

lat.description: Latitude of a spot the user wants to stay near (a venue, attraction or address), for example 35.7143 for downtown Gatlinburg. Send it together with lng instead of place.

lng.description: Longitude of the same spot, for example -83.5102. Send it together with lat.

radius_miles.description: How far from the lat/lng spot the user is willing to stay, in miles. Ignored for a place search.

tub_type.description: Set only when the user names a specific kind of tub; hotels label the same jetted tub differently, so leaving it out finds more rooms.

features.description: Room extras the user asked for, such as a fireplace in the room or bringing a dog. A hotel is returned only when it has every extra listed. romantic means a source states a tub for two, a fireplace, a heart-shaped tub or a honeymoon room.

min_rating.description: Lowest Google guest rating the user will accept, for example 4.0 for well-reviewed hotels only.

limit.description: How many hotels to show the user. The total count is returned either way.

tools.name: romantic_tub_rooms
tools.description: Find romantic hotel rooms with their own jacuzzi or hot tub: tubs sized for two, a fireplace in the room, heart-shaped tubs, honeymoon or couples rooms. Only what a source states about the room counts. Returns each hotel with the room to book, why it counts as romantic, the last check date and its tubroom.com page; strongest first.

place.description: Where the user wants to stay, as they said it: a city or town ("Gatlinburg", "Pigeon Forge, TN", "Toronto"), a US state, Canadian province or UK nation ("Ohio", "Ontario", "Wales"), or a country. Add the state after a comma when a city name is shared. Omit it for a search around a point.

lat.description: Latitude of a spot the user wants to stay near (a venue, attraction or address), for example 35.7143 for downtown Gatlinburg. Send it together with lng instead of place.

lng.description: Longitude of the same spot, for example -83.5102. Send it together with lat.

radius_miles.description: How far from the lat/lng spot the user is willing to stay, in miles. Ignored for a place search.

limit.description: How many hotels to show the user. The total count is returned either way.

tools.name: get_hotel
tools.description: Look up one hotel by name (optionally with its city) or by its tubroom.com URL. Returns the room type with the tub, the tub type, room extras, where and when it was confirmed, address and its tubroom.com page. If the hotel is not listed, says so and returns close name matches.

name.description: Hotel name as people write it, e.g. "Crossroads Inn Gatlinburg" or "Hampton Inn Pigeon Forge".

place.description: City, town or state to narrow the name search, e.g. "Gatlinburg" or "TN".

url.description: A tubroom.com hotel page URL, e.g. https://tubroom.com/gatlinburg-tn/crossroads-inn-suites/.

tools.name: list_places
tools.description: List the cities and areas Tubroom covers, with how many hotels with an in-room jacuzzi or hot tub each has and the tubroom.com list page. With no arguments returns totals per country and region; with a country or region returns its city lists.

country.description: Country to summarise by region (GB is the UK). Omit to cover all three.

region.description: A state, province or UK nation the user is interested in, by name or postal code ("Tennessee", "TN", "Ontario", "Scotland"). Returns its city lists instead of region totals.
